name: sofast
description: SOFAST POS Web Application Migration Architecture

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
